In-Depth Effect
Heals a Pokémon by 20HP

Flavour Text
Gold Silver Crystal Restores Pokémon HP by 20.
Ruby Sapphire Emerald Restores the HP of a Pokémon by 20 points.
FireRed LeafGreen A spray-type wound medicine. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.
Diamond Pearl Platinum A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.
HeartGold SoulSilver A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.
Black White A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.
Black 2 White 2 A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.
X Y A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to an injured Pokémon.
Omega Ruby Alpha Sapphire A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to an injured Pokémon.
Sun Moon A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to an injured Pokémon.
Ultra Sun Ultra Moon A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to an injured Pokémon.
Let's Go, Pikachu! Let's Go, Eevee! A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a single Pokémon.
Sword Shield A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a single Pokémon.
Brilliant Diamond Shining Pearl A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a single Pokémon.
Legends: Arceus A topical medicine meant to be applied to Pokémon. It can be used to restore 60 HP to a single Pokémon.
Scarlet Violet A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a Pokémon.
Legends: Z-A A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a Pokémon.
